motion.$description: Motion roles: how long each kind of thing that appears and goes takes to enter and exit. Component motion tokens point at these, and these point at the core motion.duration scale, so a theme retimes a whole role in one place. A change between two states that both stay on screen, Drilldown's slide and a resize point their own component tokens at the core scale, and a loop keeps its own cycle length.

reveal.$description: Content that opens in place inside the page: Disclosure, Nav and Tree groups, and Message's action row.

enter.$description: How long inline content takes to open.

exit.$description: How long inline content takes to close.

popup.$description: A surface anchored to its trigger: Popover, and Menu and the field pickers, which draw on it.

enter.$description: How long an anchored popup takes to grow in.

exit.$description: How long an anchored popup takes to shrink out.

window.$description: A window centered over the page: Dialog.

enter.$description: How long a centered window takes to rise in.

exit.$description: How long a centered window takes to leave.

panel.$description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen: Drawer and BottomSheet.

enter.$description: How long an edge panel takes to slide in.

exit.$description: How long an edge panel takes to slide out.

notice.$description: A short-lived message that appears over the page on its own: Toast.

enter.$description: How long a notice takes to appear.

exit.$description: How long a notice takes to go.
